rules.sentence: Surgical management is limited to large ASD not amenable to percutaneous device closure or MS which is not suitable for balloon mitral valvuloplasty (BMV).
Surgical management is limited to large ASD not amenable to percutaneous device closure or MS which is not suitable for balloon mitral valvuloplasty (BMV).

However, with the advancement of percutaneous interventional techniques, hardware, and more expertise, percutaneous transcatheter therapy in the form of BMV for MS and subsequently device closure for ASD, has become the preferred choice of treatment.[7][8]
